info.title: okinvo API
info.description: Invoices, credit notes, catalogue and status of one okinvo instance. Authenticate with an API key (Settings → API) or a short-lived JWT as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Every operation names the scope it needs. There is no delete or update: corrections are voids, re-issues and credit notes, as in the app.
